payload.title: Per-tenant recurring-job fan-out
payload.description: Frick recurring jobs don't fan out per tenant, so Zavro reconstructs the active-tenant list from app rows and ticks each one. Reference impl: listCompanyTenantIds in ~/dev/aquariusyacht/apps/backend/src/domains/companies/resolve.ts:36, consumed by the recurring schedules in apps/backend/src/runtime/automation.ts. The 'enumerate live tenants and run this recurring job once per tenant' capability is a scheduler concern Frick should own (it holds the tenant ledger); the app should only supply a tenant predicate/source, not the fan-out loop.
